relation_to_h_ext1n: SEPARATE IDENTITY. It does NOT rescue, revisit or reopen the H-EXT-1N gate question. That question terminated on the development split at NO_CANDIDATE_GATE_ON_DEV (H_EXT1N_GATE_FREEZE.json, selected_gate=null) and no gate is selected, scored or reported here. The frozen H-EXT-1N routing forbids scoring the EVAL split under the gate identity; this cell asks a different, pre-registered question of the same held-out sets.
question: On held-out naturalistic evidence sets (N1-EVAL, 160 sets never seen during development), (A) can the dependence-aware arm recover the dependence structure that the ClinicalTrials.gov registration oracle defines, (B) does it preserve genuine independence rather than over-triggering, and (C) does the strongest assurance parent suffice?
motivation: The P-D manuscript states it does not claim validated dependence detection in real scientific corpora, and the P-D kill/merge contract makes parent sufficiency a valid terminal. Both are answerable on this corpus with the arms already built. The development split is exhausted for gate selection but may not be used for these endpoints: it informed nothing about them, and they are frozen here before the EVAL split is dispatched.
cell: N1-EVAL (160 sets: NS1A 40, NS1B 40, NS1C 40, NS1D 40), disjoint from N1-DEV by the frozen corpus split
gate_freeze_sha256_at_freeze_time: recorded in H_EXT1N_SECONDARY_CELL_RESULT.json at analysis time; selected_gate is null
substrate: identical to N1-DEV: gpt-5.5 via codex exec --ephemeral (codex-cli 0.129.0-alpha.15) on billy-old, read-only sandbox, one call per instance per arm, FM/FG dispatch()/evaluate() unchanged
metric: exact-match accuracy on both answer keys (decision AND independent_support_family_count), paired per instance

A_DETECTION.definition: acc(M) on the dependent strata NS1A+NS1C (n=80)
A_DETECTION.pass_iff: acc >= 0.80 AND exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.01 for M vs OFF restricted to those strata
A_DETECTION.rationale: 0.80 is the floor below which the arm would be recovering less than four fifths of a dependence structure that is fully determined by the held-out registration id

B_PRESERVATION.definition: acc(M) on the independent strata NS1B+NS1D (n=80)
B_PRESERVATION.rationale: over-triggering is the failure mode the H-EXT-1 receipt flagged (imprecise activation); a dependence arm that manufactures dependence where none exists fails here

C_PARENT_SUFFICIENCY.definition: paired M vs PARENT over all 160 sets, exact two-sided McNemar

validity_gate: all three arms present on all 160 sets (no missing/EXECUTION_FAILED); extract-time canary passes on every task; EVAL study's corpus_freeze_sha256 matches the frozen corpus; EVAL task ids disjoint from DEV task ids. Any failure -> CANNOT_CHECK_RUN_INVALID and no endpoint is read.
reporting_only_never_routing: per-stratum n / M / OFF / PARENT counts

witness informativeness: for each of the six frozen H-EXT-1 candidate gates, activation precision and recall against the oracle-active strata NS1A/NS1C on EVAL (quantifies whether the witnesses carry dependence information even though no gate could improve accuracy on DEV)
family-count error distribution (predicted minus true independent_support_family_count)
no_rescue: endpoints, thresholds, strata groupings and terminals are fixed by this file before the EVAL split is dispatched. No re-thresholding, stratum exclusion, arm substitution or metric change afterwards. A failed endpoint is recorded under its routed terminal; any repair is a new identity with its own freeze.
honest_limits: OFF's failure on the dependent strata is close to tautological given its arm instruction (treat every item as independent); the informative quantities are M's detection rate and its preservation rate, not the M-OFF gap itself, which is reported for continuity with the P-D ablation and not as the discovery

the oracle is registration identity, so two separately registered publications of one programme count as independent; endpoint B therefore charges M for correctly noticing a dependence the oracle does not encode
one model family (gpt-5.5); abstracts and metadata only
records come from trials with at least two indexed publications, a selected slice of the literature
